quotes.author: Michael Avila
quotes.text: Michael Avila6 years agoGreat time with family. Enjoyed every minute. Loved that 4 year old son and 7 year niece loved it. They want to do it again. We will probably go back soon. Great that we can take snacks and drinks. Thank you Jay for showing us how to operate boat. and thank you Victoria for helping with reservation. Definitely recommend it for a family get together. Maybe even a birthday party. I get easily sea sick and this didn’t bother me.

quotes.author: frances l
quotes.text: frances l6 years agoJust got back from a WONDERFUL time on the boat. Staff was very helpful and friendly, especially JAY, who even gave directions to someone in our party that was lost. Very clean, comfortable, easy to drive, and could even hook up music from our cell phone.Great evening for me to celebrate a birthday with our family. Plan on returning during Christmas too. Thanks OC Boat Rentals for a great 2 hours of FUN!!!

quotes.author: Chuck Hartman
quotes.text: Chuck Hartman6 years agoThis is a great electric boat rental company. The people could not be nicer or more helpful, the boats are very nice and unlike all of the other rental companies, the parking area is huge and easy. Do yourself a favor, save some money and skip Duffy. You will not be sorry. Oh, and they take our doggie friends!

quotes.author: ramy herrera
quotes.text: ramy herrera6 years agoI rented a pontoon for my mom's birthday and we had the best time. Thunder was the primary person helping us and he was so friendly and helpful. Our boat was extremely clean and well taken care of. I would recommend OC Boat Rentals and I will definitely be booking a boat from them in the future.

quotes.author: Vicki Waller
quotes.text: Vicki Waller6 years agoOur Duffy boat was very clean, and ready for us when we arrived. The staff were very helpful getting us signed in and onboard. We enjoyed a two-hour cruise around Newport Harbor viewing holiday lights and celebrating birthdays. We had a great time!

quotes.author: Stacy Richards
quotes.text: Stacy Richards6 years agoThis is the 2nd time this month we have rented the pontoon boat from OC Boat Rentals. The staff was super friendly and the boat was super clean. We had such a great day and look forward to renting from them again in the future.
